Name: Toni's Crystal Clear
Author: TONIMELONI891011
Description:
The Toni returns with my first original mod! I present to you... Toni's Crystal Clear! As a long-term, community-collaborative passion project that is planned to expand years into the future, you are going to be able to expect a LOT from this mod in the future!

While there are only 16 minerals (17 nodes) on launch, you can expect a lot more in the future! Geology themed NPCs, furniture, artisan goods, and much more are planned as I slowly learn more things!

CURRENT FEATURES: 

•20 Ore Nodes spawning on nearly all floors in the normal mines and SC !!should NOT interfere with any other mods!!
•19 Gemstones Donateable to the museum

PLANNED FEATURES:

•Documentation of mineral information 
•More ores
•Gemstone Polishing
•More to come!

5 minerals have been hand drawn by me, with other contributors including:

-Void (7)
-Wiz (1)
-Nonparelli (2)
-Zelda (1)
-WhiteBalverines (6)

There will eventually be a list of minerals to choose from, as well as the ore's stats, credits, etc.

INSTALLATION: 

1. Download
2. Place into the Mods folder in the game

UNINSTALLING:

Delete the TCC folder

!!WARNING!! Removal of this mod will cause error items in the museum 

Want to contribute? A few rules!

1. In-game retextures are okay!
2. Must be somewhat familiar with pixel art
3. Minerals can only be done ONCE (there are over 6,000 minerals out there, not including the rocks!!)
4. Must be a real mineral (sci-fi comes later, contributions there still welcome!)
5. Only ONE mineral per person will be donateable for the forseeable future (planning on a 2nd museum, but that's far away)

You can contact me on the SDV discord or Nexus forums! Happy hunting!
